question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

GAR, AXS, UUT, ORU, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter → (6) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 
 
• Third letter → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/728ab51777ede6d293da4e6ea4518b685d5d8ea084ef02e9857b2cd42d907c6a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**IOV**".
